text: Dinner was perfect. Momo, laughs, the whole gang. [amazed] Then the bill arrived.
Two beers, one chowmein nobody remembers ordering, ten percent service, thirteen percent VAT... and someone opens the calculator.
Split-Up now has AI. Meet Smart Split.
It reads every item, the service charge and the VAT, even the Nepali date.
Then just tell it who had what.
Every share, worked out to the paisa, and checked against the bill.
No photo? Just type it the way you text. English, Nepali, or both.
Tap save, and the whole group sees it live.
Every month, your first five AI bills are free.
Want more? Share your invite code.
When a friend signs up with it, you both get five more. And they never expire.
So next time the bill arrives... snap it, say it, and you're square before the tea gets cold.
Split-Up is coming soon to the Play Store and the App Store. But you can have it today.
On Android, open the site in Chrome, tap the menu, then Install app.
On iPhone, open it in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
Snap the bill. Say who had what. Stay friends. Splitup dot thimitech dot com.
